title: Trash Boats for the Bubbler Regatta
description: Create a boat that is wind powered. You may supply your own wind by blowing on the sail or think about a box fan to generate wind. Create a testing arena to make sure your boat floats and that you are able to navigate it effectively.
required_materials: Things that float - pool noodles; shipping foam; corks; cardboard boxes or juice containers
Other recycled or reused containers or materials
Mast materials - skewers; toothpicks; lollipop or popsicle sticks; straws
Sail materials - old library cards; cardstock; mylar sheeting; fabric
Joinery - twisty ties; pipe cleaners; hot glue (we often just stick things together into pool noodle foam)
Ballast - pennies; washers; brads; nails or screws

title: Stacking!
description: Playing with blocks, considering balance, weight, coordination, and planning are collaborative and problem solving opportunities.   No consumable materials, unless you want them, rolling paper and using tape is always an option, but we are curious what you can make with the materials you have on hand.

links.label: Me whenever i stumble upon a stack of books 📚 #Ghostbusters
Stack the Cats, instructions - Google Docs

The Art of Trader Joe’s on Instagram: "Swipe to see how Trader Joe’s artists transformed an endcap display for #cincodemayo! 🇲🇽🎉 Take a close look and you might see a secret “5” and “Mayo” encoded in the stacked cans. 👀🙌

In late April, this display featured separate stacked columns of beans, chiles, and taco shells. A few days later, Trader Joe’s crew members rearranged the display, intermixing cans of Black Beans and Green Chiles. To celebrate Cinco de Mayo, they encoded a “5” in the upper portion of the display and the word “Mayo” in the lower portion. The crew brilliantly takes advantage of the color contrast between the cans, embedding a covert message for those who take the time to notice it. 

Stacking is an art form at Trader Joe’s. If you look closely enough, you might be surprised at the secret messages you discover on the shelves! As with many of my favorite artworks at Trader Joe’s, stacked installations are ephemeral—they can appear and disappear in a matter of days. 

Shoutout to the 2023 crew in the Millburn NJ store for this display!

#art #stacking #grocery #cincodemayo #holiday #creative"
36 People Who Turned Log Piling Into An Art Form | Bored Panda

title: Drawing Data
description: Inspired by Spotify Unwrapped and other shared examples: Create a “_____” Unwrapped for 2025. Visualize some data, patterns, or trends from your life this year.
required_materials: Paper (post-its; copy paper; the back of an envelope)
Drawing materials (your favorite pen; some markers; colored pencils; highlighters)
Craft materials (pony beads; pipe cleaners; paper clips; whatever is lying around)
nice_to_have_materials: Collect some data about your year. It doesn't have to be precise or serious. How many times did you go outside each week; was the sun out? Which song did you listen to most each month? Which are your most used emojis?

links.label: Illustrated Graphs: Using Art to Enliven Scientific Data - Science Friday
